tasks.label: kill-port-8080
tasks.command: $connections = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8080 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($connections) { $processIds = $connections | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique; foreach ($processId in $processIds) { Stop-Process -Id $processId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }
